name: Withered Bone
description: Misc item, a giant bone knotted like old wood. Internal ID WitheredBone, stack 30, weight 1.0.
usedFor: Crafting: listed as an ingredient in the Nimble Anklet (amount and station not stated on this page)
Boss summon: ten Withered Bones are needed to summon the third boss, Bonemass, at the Forsaken altar
obtainedFrom: Muddy scrap piles in Sunken Crypts
Chests in the Swamp biome

name: Tar
description: Material, a sticky lump of tar. Internal ID Tar, stack 50, weight 2.0.
usedFor: Building (page lists pieces but gives no amounts): Black metal chest, Carved darkwood divider, Darkwood arch, Darkwood beam 2m, Darkwood beam 4m, Darkwood beam 26°, Darkwood beam 45°, Darkwood chair, Darkwood gate, Darkwood pole 2m, Darkwood pole 4m, Hot tub, Long heavy table, Raven adornment, Round table, Wolf adornment
Building, roofs (no amounts): Shingle roof 26°, ridge 26°, o-corner 26°, i-corner 26°, Shingle roof 45°, ridge 45°, o-corner 45°, i-corner 45°
Crafting: Blob bomb (amount not stated on the Tar page)
obtainedFrom: Dropped by Growths
Found in and around Tar pits in the Plains biome

name: Sharpening Stone
description: Material, a whetstone wheel. Internal ID SharpeningStone, stack 20, weight 6.0.
usedFor: Building: Grinding wheel (the only piece the page lists)
obtainedFrom: Crafted at the Stonecutter
Rarely found in Plains chests in Fuling Villages, Fuling Outposts and Fuling Ruins

name: Bell
description: Misc item used to summon the Ashlands boss Fader. Internal ID Bell, stack 9, weight 0.5.
usedFor: Boss summon: three Bells summon Fader (9 Bell fragments in total)
obtainedFrom: Crafted at the Black forge from Bell fragments
Bell fragments come from Charred Fortresses (Ashlands)
recipe: Bell fragment x3 at the Black forge

name: Torch
description: Club-type utility weapon and light source. Internal ID Torch.
usedFor: Light source; when equipped it acts like a fire and scares off Necks, untamed Boars, Greylings and Greydwarfs
Weapon: blunt 4 plus fire 15 damage, 3-hit combo
Can be held in main or off hand
obtainedFrom: The player starts the game with one
Craftable (see recipe)
gameVersionNote: not stated. Contradiction on the page: the infobox says Source is the player crafting menu, while the upgrade table says Workbench level 1. It loses durability while equipped and lasts at most 10 minutes; it cannot be repaired.

name: Hammer
description: Tool used to build fires, workbenches, buildings and furniture. Internal ID Hammer.
usedFor: Building: opens the build menu with right click (you cannot block while holding it)
obtainedFrom: Recipe unlocked from the start of the game; no crafting station needed
recipe: Quality 1: Wood x3, Stone x2 (no station). Upgrades: quality 2 Wood x1 Stone x1 (workbench level 2), quality 3 Wood x2 Stone x2 (workbench level 3)

name: Hoe
description: Tool for levelling or raising ground and laying paths. Internal ID Hoe.
usedFor: Levelling, raising and slightly lowering ground; raising ground costs 2 Stone per operation and needs a workbench nearby
Applying Pathen and Paved Road ground decorations
obtainedFrom: Crafted at the Workbench
recipe: Wood x5, Stone x2 at Workbench level 1. Upgrades: quality 2 Wood x1 Stone x1 (workbench level 2), quality 3 Wood x2 Stone x2 (workbench level 3)

name: Cultivator
description: Farming tool for tilling soil, planting seeds and trees, and restoring grass. Internal ID Cultivator.
usedFor: Preparing cultivated soil for food crops
Planting trees (needs cleared space, not cultivated ground)
Grass mode: regrow grass, lily pads, create sand on shoreline, regrow cattails in some shore areas
Uses stamina; the page says Hildir's clothing helps on large farms
obtainedFrom: Crafted at a Forge; becomes available once you have Bronze and Corewood
recipe: Corewood x5, Bronze x5 at the Forge. Upgrades: quality 2 Corewood x1 Bronze x1, quality 3 Corewood x2 Bronze x2

name: Beech Seeds
description: Seed that grows a Beech tree when planted with the Cultivator. Internal ID BeechSeeds, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator to grow a Beech tree; grow time 3000-5000 s; no cultivated ground needed; needs 4 m of space
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest and Plains; cannot grow in the Swamp
obtainedFrom: Beech trees

name: Birch Seeds
description: Seed that grows a Birch tree when planted with the Cultivator. Internal ID BirchSeeds, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator to grow a Birch tree; grow time 5000-7000 s; no cultivated ground needed; needs 4 m of space
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest and Plains
obtainedFrom: Birch trees; the drop rate depends on whether the tree was planted and which biome it came from (details are on another page)

name: Fir Cone
description: Seed that grows a Fir tree when planted. Internal ID FirCone, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator to farm Fir trees as a Wood source; grow time 3000-5000 s; needs 4 m of space; no cultivated ground needed
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest, Mountain and Plains
Building: Yule tree
obtainedFrom: Picked up from felled Fir trees

name: Pine Cone
description: Seed that grows a Pine tree when planted. Internal ID PineCone, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator to grow Pine trees; grow time 3000-5000 s; needs a fair amount of open space; no cultivated ground needed
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest and Plains
Building: Yule garland, Yule wreath
obtainedFrom: Dropped when cutting down Pines

name: Carrot Seeds
description: Seed for growing Carrots. Internal ID CarrotSeeds, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator on cultivated ground; grow time 4000-5000 s; needs 1 m of space
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest and Plains
Planting a grown Carrot with the Cultivator option "Seed-carrot" gives three seeds
obtainedFrom: Found on the ground in the Black Forest (picked seeds do not respawn)
Three seeds from using the Seed-carrot option on a Carrot
gameVersionNote: not stated. Page is inconsistent about yield: the infobox says it produces 3 Carrots, the text says planting grows 1x Carrot.

name: Turnip Seeds
description: Seed for growing Turnips. Internal ID TurnipSeeds, stack 100.
usedFor: Farming: plant with the Cultivator on cultivated ground; grow time 4000-5000 s; needs 1 m of space
Grows in Meadows, Black Forest, Swamp, Plains and Mistlands
Planting a grown Turnip with the Cultivator option "Seed-turnip" gives three seeds
obtainedFrom: Harvest the flowers of Turnip plants in the Swamp (picked seeds do not respawn; the page says they are harder to find than carrot seeds)
Three seeds from using the Seed-turnip option on a Turnip
gameVersionNote: not stated. Page is inconsistent about yield: the infobox says it produces 3 Turnips, the text says planting grows 1x Turnip.

name: Dragon Egg
description: Misc item, very heavy (200.0), stack 1, cannot go through a portal. Internal ID DragonEgg.
usedFor: Boss summon: three Dragon Eggs summon the fourth boss, Moder (Forsaken altar)
obtainedFrom: Drake nests in the Mountains; up to 3 Drakes guard each egg
Tip on the page: collect them in the same Mountain biome as the Moder altar, no need to haul them far
gameVersionNote: not stated. Page contradicts itself on respawn: one note says eggs do not respawn, another says they respawn after 8 h. A separate item, Powdered dragon eggshells, is sold by the Bog Witch (not covered here).

name: Dragon Tear
description: Material, the last frozen tear of a dragon. Internal ID DragonTear, stack 50.
usedFor: Building: Artisan table
Can be placed on an item stand; emits light and fog particles
obtainedFrom: Moder drops 10 when defeated

name: Celestial Feather
description: Material from the Ashlands, a remnant of a fallen valkyrie. Internal ID CelestialFeather, stack 50.
usedFor: Building: Feathery wreath
Crafting: Staff of the Wild Dundr (amount and station not stated on this page)
obtainedFrom: Fallen Valkyries drop 2 to 3 on death (Ashlands)
Charred chests inside Charred Fortresses

name: Wisplight
description: Accessory (internal ID Demister) that clears the Mistlands mist around you.
usedFor: Clears Mist in a 10 m radius; the orb loosely follows the player
Takes the accessory slot, so full armor can still be worn; conflicts with the Megingjord and the Wishbone (same slot)
obtainedFrom: Crafted at a Workbench (level 1); unlocked after getting a Wisp for the first time
recipe: Silver x1, Wisp x1 at Workbench level 1

name: Majestic Carapace
description: Material dropped by The Queen. Internal ID QueenDrop, stack 30.
usedFor: Building: required to build the Artisan press
obtainedFrom: The Queen drops 5 on defeat, unaffected by the resource rate
gameVersionNote: Before the Ashlands update this item was named "Queen drop" and was a placeholder.

name: Fuling Totem
description: Rare Plains item that channels the power of Yagluth. Internal ID GoblinTotem, stack 30.
usedFor: Boss summon: five Fuling Totems summon Yagluth, the fifth boss (Forsaken altar)
obtainedFrom: Fuling Villages: 50% chance next to each Bonfire
Guaranteed inside some variants of Fuling Outposts
10% drop from Fuling Berserkers
2.8% drop from chests in Stonehenges
If the pedestal holding the totem is destroyed before you interact with it, no totem drops

name: Fishing Rod
description: Two-handed tool for fishing. Internal ID FishingRod, weight 1.5.
usedFor: Fishing: primary attack casts the line (needs bait in inventory; hold longer to cast up to 30 m); block reels in the bobber and any caught fish
One bait is used per cast
Weak melee: blunt 5
obtainedFrom: Bought from Haldor for 350 Coins
Found at the edge of large frozen lakes in rare Frost Caves; picking it up there also drops 2-4 Fishing bait
Cannot be crafted
gameVersionNote: As of patch 0.213.4, bait is returned if the line is pulled in without catching a fish or when recasting. The Fishing overview page describes the Frost Cave rod as near a rare runestone, the rod page says at the edge of large frozen lakes.

name: Fishing Bait
description: Basic fishing bait (the wiki's "Fishing bait" redirects to the Bait page, which covers all bait types). All baits weigh 0.1 and stack to 100.
usedFor: Fishing: attach to the Fishing Rod by equipping it and right-clicking the bait in the inventory; the bait type decides which fish bite
Basic Fishing bait attracts Perch and Pike (Meadows, Black Forest)
Crafting ingredient for advanced baits at the Food preparation table: 20 Fishing bait plus 1 trophy gives 20 advanced bait
obtainedFrom: Sold by Haldor: 10 Coins per 20 bait
2-4 bait drop when picking up the Fishing Rod found in a Frost Cave
recipe: Advanced bait types (20 basic bait + trophy -> 20 bait): Mossy (Troll trophy) attracts Trollfish, Black Forest; Sticky (Abomination trophy) attracts Giant herring, Swamp; Stingy (Fuling trophy) attracts Grouper, Plains; Heavy (Serpent trophy) attracts Tuna and Coral cod, Ocean; Misty (Lox trophy) attracts Pufferfish and Anglerfish, Mistlands (both) and Ocean (Pufferfish); Hot (Warrior trophy) attracts Magmafish, Ashlands; Frosty (Drake trophy) attracts Northern salmon, Deep North; Cold (Fenring trophy) attracts Pike (Meadows and Black Forest) and Tetra (Frost Caves)
gameVersionNote: The Fishing page says the different fish and bait types were introduced in the Mistlands update.

name: Perch
description: Fish, a tasty whitemeat fish. Internal ID fish1.
usedFor: Crafting: Fishing hat
Cooking: Raw fish (the page lists "Raw fish" under usage and gives no cooked result)
Crafting: Mead base: Vananidir
Decoration: can be mounted on an item stand
Catching a Perch can give a bonus Amber drop (per the Amber page)
obtainedFrom: Fishing: coastal fish found offshore in the Meadows and Black Forest, caught with the basic Fishing bait sold by Haldor

name: Pike
description: Fish, a freshwater fish. Internal ID fish2.
usedFor: Crafting: Fishing hat
Cooking: Raw fish (the page lists "Raw fish" under usage and gives no cooked result)
Decoration
Catching a Pike can give a bonus Amber pearl drop (per the Amber pearl page)
obtainedFrom: Fishing: found offshore in the Meadows and Black Forest, caught with Fishing bait from Haldor or Cold fishing bait (20 Fishing bait + Fenring trophy at the Food preparation table)
gameVersionNote: not stated. Wording quirk: the flavour text calls it freshwater while the body calls it a coastal fish found offshore.

name: Bukeperries
description: Consumable berry that makes you sick, used to clear active food buffs. Internal ID Pukeberries, stack 50.
usedFor: Clearing active Food buffs: gives the Feeling sick effect for 15 s (no health or stamina regen, -50% movement speed, 1 damage every 2 s, and each tick removes one consumed food)
Lets you swap foods without waiting for them to expire; the removed foods are wasted
The page says eating Rotten meat has the same effect (a late-game alternative)
obtainedFrom: Dropped by Fuling shamans
Dropped by Greydwarf shamans

name: Amber
description: Valuable item. Internal ID Amber, stack 20.
usedFor: Selling: any trader buys it for 5 Coins
obtainedFrom: Stone Graves and Viking Graveyards in the Meadows
Burial Chambers in the Black Forest
Sunken Crypts in the Swamp
Fishing: bonus drop when catching Perch

name: Amber Pearl
description: Valuable item. Internal ID AmberPearl, stack 50.
usedFor: Selling: any trader buys it for 10 Coins
Crafting: Celebratory cap (amount not stated on this page)
obtainedFrom: Stone Graves and Viking Graveyards in the Meadows
Burial Chambers and Troll Caves in the Black Forest
Sunken Crypts in the Swamp
Fishing: bonus drop when catching Pike

name: Swamp Key
description: Misc key item. Internal ID CryptKey, stack 1.
usedFor: Unlocks the gates of Sunken Crypts in the Swamp; must be in your inventory the first time each crypt gate is opened, not needed to re-enter the same crypt; not consumed (unlimited uses)
obtainedFrom: Dropped by The Elder when defeated (Black Forest)

name: Wishbone
description: Accessory that helps find buried secrets. Internal ID Wishbone.
usedFor: When equipped, green particles and a ding sound appear within about 20 m of a buried secret; the ding speeds up and rises in pitch as you get closer, and the wishbone pulses directly above it
Digging reveals Muddy scrap piles (Swamp), Silver veins (Mountain) or Buried Treasure (Meadows); once interacted with, it stops detecting that object
Conflicts with the Megingjord and the Wisplight (same equipment slot)
obtainedFrom: Dropped by Bonemass (Swamp)
